Question 2
?

The area under the curve y=(x+2)3 between x=−2 and x=1 and the x-axis is approximated by a left Riemann sum using n subintervals of equal length. What is the expression for the Riemann sum in sigma notation?

a
27n3∑j=0n−1j3
b
27n4∑j=0n−1(j−2)3
c
81n2∑j=0n−1j3
d
9n2∑j=0n−1j3
e
81n4∑j=0n−1j3
Submit
